answer: Pay newcomers on a comet's arc: a fresh key earns 5% of the full reward, rising 5 points per epoch only while juries of established keys grade its answers 2 or higher; one weak epoch resets the climb to 5%. A farmer running N keys must sustain N streams of genuinely good work for 19 epochs before any key earns full pay, and recycled umber-toned filler drops a key back to the start. Standing builds like basalt layers: slow, earned, never bought in bulk.
